Miami, FL.excerpt: A family that planned a five-month visit for a grandchild's birth was admitted only until November 2026 at the Miami port of entry — a case immigration attorney Gnanamookan Senthurjothi says exposes the common myth that a B1/B2 visa guarantees a six-month stay.
